description: Defines classes for WebTransport stream visitors used in testing, including discard, echo, and session visitors, within the quic namespace.

classes.name: WebTransportDiscardVisitor
classes.description: Visitor that discards incoming data on a WebTransport stream.

classes.name: WebTransportBidirectionalEchoVisitor
classes.description: Visitor that echoes data bidirectionally on a WebTransport stream.

classes.name: WebTransportUnidirectionalEchoReadVisitor
classes.description: Visitor that buffers all data read from a unidirectional WebTransport stream and calls a callback.

classes.name: WebTransportUnidirectionalEchoWriteVisitor
classes.description: Visitor that writes supplied data to a WebTransport stream and sends a FIN.

classes.name: EchoWebTransportSessionVisitor
classes.description: Session visitor that manages incoming streams and datagrams, echoing streams and handling session events.

methods.name: OnCanRead
methods.description: Handles readiness to read data from the stream.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Handles readiness to write data to the stream.

methods.name: OnResetStreamReceived
methods.description: Handles receipt of a stream reset error.

methods.name: OnStopSendingReceived
methods.description: Handles receipt of a stop sending error.

methods.name: OnWriteSideInDataRecvdState
methods.description: Handles the event when the write side is in data received state.

methods.name: OnIncomingBidirectionalStreamAvailable
methods.description: Handles availability of incoming bidirectional streams.

methods.name: OnIncomingUnidirectionalStreamAvailable
methods.description: Handles availability of incoming unidirectional streams.

methods.name: OnCanCreateNewOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Creates a new outgoing bidirectional stream if possible.

methods.name: OnCanCreateNewOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Creates a new outgoing unidirectional stream if possible.

methods.name: TrySendingUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Attempts to send buffered unidirectional streams.
